5. A yellow "HANDLE NÅ" (Shop now) button
6. A large image on the right showing what appears to be a wooden building with the Northern Lights in the background
7. Standard website icons in the top right (search, user account, shopping cart with 0 items)

The text appears to be in Norwegian rather than English as mentioned in the question, but the layout is intact with no obvious issues.
